courses.matric: We offer Matric (Science & Arts) tuition covering Math, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, and English.
courses.o_level: We offer O Level courses in Math, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Computer Science and English.
courses.a_level: We offer A Level courses in Math, Physics, Chemistry, Biology and Computer Science.
courses.spoken_english: We offer a Spoken English course for beginners and intermediate learners.
courses.programming: We offer Python Programming and Web Development courses for students of all levels.
courses.general: Sir Osmani Academy offers online tuition for Matric, O Level, A Level, Spoken English and Programming courses.

class_timings.weekday: Classes run Monday to Friday, 4 PM to 9 PM.
class_timings.weekend: Weekend batches are available on Saturday, 10 AM to 4 PM.

teachers.general: All our teachers are qualified subject specialists with at least 5 years of online teaching experience.
teachers.demo: We offer a free demo class before enrollment so you can meet the teacher and evaluate the teaching style.

fees.general: Course fees range from PKR 3,000 to PKR 8,000 per month depending on the subject and level.
fees.discount: We offer a 10% discount for sibling enrollments and a 15% discount for full-course advance payment.
fees.payment_methods: We accept payments via Bank Transfer, JazzCash, EasyPaisa and Credit/Debit Card.

location.general: Sir Osmani Academy operates fully online, so students can join classes from anywhere via Zoom or Google Meet.

enrollment.general: To enroll, fill out the registration form on our website or contact us via WhatsApp, and our team will guide you through the process.

services.general: We provide recorded lecture access, weekly quizzes, homework support, and monthly progress reports.
